definitions.name: _status_for_session
definitions.docstring:
Resolve the historical operational status at the target session open.

A missing transition log cannot establish an earlier status. The first
recorded `from` status is the baseline for older sessions, bounded by
model creation. An artifact version change makes old gaps unrecoverable
with the current boosters.

definitions.name: backfill

Create missing operational predictions for recent observed sessions.

This deliberately uses the production artifacts and tracked models at
execution time. It is not the historical simulation/replay mechanism.

definitions.name: replay
definitions.docstring:
Replay active models using only information preceding each target session.

The persisted production boosters cannot safely be applied backwards:
they were trained using observations that may postdate the simulated
session.  Daily mode therefore fits on an expanding sample ending at
each ``as_of_date``.  Frozen mode fits once at the as-of date before
the first simulated session.  Both preserve the model's frozen feature
definition, XGBoost parameters, and decision thresholds.

definitions.name: evaluate

``update`` remains backward compatible and persists only complete realized
results.  The evaluation frame is the additive contract consumed later
by the Production quality reconciliation service.

files.docstring:

The universe identifier is already persisted with a promoted model.  A name is

presenting a subsequently renamed universe as its historical promotion name.

historical metrics contribute a neutral 0.5 component. A missing edge
contributes zero because an absent calibrated threshold must never improve
a signal's rank.
